source: nflverse play-by-play; current-season completed games refreshed daily, with corrections; historical seasons retain their dated snapshots. See data.coverage for exact games, source hash and timestamps.
note: Regular season only, plays with a down (excludes kickoffs/XPs/etc). Per-season tables use a 200-dropback minimum for QBs; the pooled table uses 500. 2026 covers Weeks 1-5 ONLY (78 games) — a small sample sensitive to opponent and game script; its QB minimum is the 200 bar prorated to 58 dropbacks. The pooled table spans every season in the snapshot, including the partial one. These are descriptive aggregates, not projections — team EPA is famously unstable year to year, so do not read 2025 as 2026, and do not interpret an incomplete season as a complete season. Dropback EPA counts every dropback including scrambles and penalty-nullified plays and uses play epa, not qb_epa; Rush EPA excludes scrambles and kneels. These will not match nflverse passing_epa / rushing_epa.

field_notes.off_epa_play: offensive EPA per play (higher is better)
field_notes.def_epa_play: EPA per play allowed (LOWER is better — sign is not flipped)
field_notes.cpoe: completion percentage over expected, percentage points

2026.note: Completed games only, including incomplete weeks. Daily published nflverse EPA; not live. Historical seasons retained; current-season corrections incorporated.

tier_meaning: Working Dawg — earned its collar. Evidence survived validation: receipts against a benchmark chosen in advance for forecasters, named sources and reproducible maths for measurement tools.
